summary: Decodes PosiStageNet protocol data into CHOP channels for tracked object position, orientation, speed, acceleration, and target position.
key_concepts: PosiStageNet CHOP receives PosiStageNet tracking data from a server, device, or software endpoint.
The default TCP port is 56565, and firewall settings may need adjustment for communication to work.
It can output position, Euler orientation, speed, acceleration, and target-position channels.
Any number of tracked objects can be represented, so downstream channel sets may grow as tracked objects appear.
Reset Pulse clears all data channels and removes untracked or stale data.
Use BlackTrax CHOP for BlackTrax-specific workflows rather than generic PosiStageNet protocol input.

key_params.name: port
key_params.note: Network port, default TCP port is 56565

common_gotchas: PosiStageNet can track any number of objects, so downstream channel sets can grow with tracked object count.
Firewall settings may need adjustment for the default TCP port 56565.
Reset Pulse clears all data channels, removing untracked/stale data.
Orientation is output as Euler angles; generated plans should convert carefully if quaternion/continuous rotation is needed.
The protocol is common in stage lighting, sound, and projection mapping, so local network timing and coordinate conventions matter.
See BlackTrax CHOP when the tracking system is BlackTrax-specific rather than generic PosiStageNet.
